environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. The application listens on port 8080, ELB forwards TCP/443 to TCP/8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy between ELB and application. Auth tokens are issued by a separate identity service sharing the same SECRET_KEY.
